descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 25 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# CRICKETX — MOST REALISTIC PHYSICS BASED TRAINING

Step into highly realistic physics-based VR cricket where batting feel, ball movement and pitch behaviour matter. CricketX simulates pace, swing, spin, seam, bounce and bat-ball interaction—with control and analytics for purposeful practice.


**REALISTIC BATTING & BOWLING.**

[media]

Read the bowler, judge the delivery and commit to the shot. Bat right- or left-handed on immersive pitch, with ball behaviour shaped by delivery and pitch settings.

**CONTROL THE DELIVERY**

[media]

Set line, length, speed, swing, spin, bowling side, pitch pace and bounce. Build a net around one weakness, or mix deliveries to test reading and shot selection.

**TRAIN UNDER PRESSURE**

[media]

Move from open practice into target chases, Faceoff, local pass-and-play and curated challenges. Rehearse decisions as the situation changes.

**REVIEW. ADAPT. RETEST.**

[media]

Replay shots from multiple angles. Study pitch maps, wagon wheels, trajectories, matchups, timing, contact and dismissals. Technique views surface head movement and gaze-at-contact cues.

**FEEL THE BAT**

Touch controllers work on their own. For the most authentic CricketX experience, mount one in a compatible real bat. The controller tracks your real swing while the bat adds physical weight, balance, grip and reach. Passthrough keeps your surroundings visible. No PC or console required.

CricketX complements coaching and net practice. CricketX Pro is optional and unlocks Analysis Mode and selected premium scenarios.
